correctness.rationale: Directly reconstructed each of the four (c,h,q) triples for either actual parent color. A pending white child must be served by its parent; a white parent cannot serve it, while a black parent serves it exactly when its white children plus its white external parent total one. A black child with q=1 has no white children and therefore witnesses its white parent. These exhaustive local cases induce the exact messages with no duplicated colorings. Root t=1 and h=0 excludes an imaginary witness; component products include empty forests and isolated vertices. Leaf initialization is 1 for white pending and x for black. Capping w at 2 and using booleans for r,s gives at most twelve intermediate states, eight messages, and O(n^3) integer arithmetic. An entirely separately written recurrence compared equal to direct subset enumeration for 2243 independent cases: every labeled tree through six vertices plus 800 seeded forest samples with orders through ten. This finite test supports but does not replace the unrestricted inductive proof.

value.rationale: The 2022 primary paper poses counting minimum super-dominating sets of arbitrary trees, a natural unresolved enumerative quantity. A full all-cardinality polynomial on each forest is stronger, and the explicit local pending-witness states provide an implementable uniformly bounded combinatorial recurrence rather than only an abstract tractability metatheorem. The method handles arbitrary degree, disconnection, isolated vertices and empty forest; the first nonzero coefficient counts minimum sets using the previously known maximum-matching degree. Not a claim of minimal state count, general cyclic graphs or a generic new tractability theorem.

limitations: Only forests, no cycles; polynomial arithmetic O(n^3) ignores bit-operation factor, coefficients can have O(n) bits.
